description: List sessions teammates have shared. Defaults to the current repo; pass all_repos to see everything. for_me lists handoffs assigned to you (from any repo).

all_repos.description: List sessions from every repo, not just the current one

branch.description: Only sessions shared from this git branch

file.description: Only sessions that touched this file (part of the path is fine)

limit.description: How many to return, newest first (default 10)

tool.description: Only sessions from this coding agent

name: list_sessions
title: List shared sessions
